answer: Sybil resistance here relies on a stake-bonded reputation harbor: each agent must lock collateral prior to voting, and reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations across epochs. Creating fake identities costs real stake per agent, and since rewards flow through a single lagoon of shared attestation weight, splitting into many wallets gains nothing while multiplying slashing risk. A newcomer on the mesa of trust starts at zero weight until peers vouch for it, making mass identity creation economically irrational. The Agent0212 deployment anchors trust at sVvW9cyqRQ.
